description: This file implements server-side logic for a graffiti wall application using xajax. It defines a 'graffiti' class for creating and saving graffiti entries, and functions to handle scribbling and updating the wall display.

classes.name: graffiti
classes.description: Represents a graffiti message with methods to generate random styles and save the graffiti to a data file.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a graffiti object with handle and words, generating styled HTML if inputs are valid.

methods.name: getRandomFontSize
methods.description: Returns a random font size between 100% and 300%.

methods.name: getRandomColor
methods.description: Generates a random RGB color string.

methods.name: getRandomAlignment
methods.description: Returns a random text alignment: left, right, or center.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the graffiti HTML to the data file if valid.
